name: CareerForge-AI
description: AI career coach with BM25 RAG, prompt-injection defence, PII redaction and an evaluation dashboard (Streamlit + Gemini)

paragraphs: An AI career coach that is grounded in curated knowledge, hardened against prompt injection, private by default, and measured with a built-in evaluation dashboard.
Features · Screenshots · Architecture · Technical deep dive · Results · Getting started · Limitations

CareerForge AI takes a resume and walks the candidate through a complete career-preparation journey: analysis → skill gap → roadmap → portfolio projects → mock interview. Each stage is a dedicated Gemini-powered agent.
features: Supported target roles: AI / Machine Learning Engineer · Data Scientist · Data Analyst · Software Engineer · Full Stack Developer · Cybersecurity Engineer · Cloud Engineer · DevOps Engineer.
BM25 retrieval-augmented generation over a 40-chunk curated knowledge base, with role aliases and abstention when a role is not covered
Prompt-injection defence with 18 detection rules, sentence-level neutralization, randomized isolation markers and output grounding
Privacy redaction of emails, phone numbers, profile links, ID numbers, dates of birth, addresses and names, with a preview of what the AI sees and a Delete my data button
Evaluation dashboard (Streamlit page) for retrieval, security, privacy and live-model metrics

whatItDoes.text: An AI career coach that is grounded in curated knowledge, hardened against prompt injection, private by default, and measured with a built-in evaluation dashboard.

requirements.text: 176 tests, no network or API key needed to run them
